courses.name: General Aptitude
courses.about: Verbal, quantitative, analytical and spatial ability (GATE, placements)

chapters.name: Verbal Aptitude
topics: Grammar: tenses, articles, prepositions and agreement
Vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms and words in context

chapters.name: Quantitative Aptitude
topics: Profit and loss, simple and compound interest
Data interpretation: tables, bar graphs and pie charts

chapters.name: Spatial Aptitude
topics: Rotation, reflection and scaling of shapes
Patterns in two and three dimensions
